name: Browserbase
tagline: Cloud browsers for AI agents and automation.
shortDescription: Hosted browser sessions, stealth infrastructure, and automation tools for agent workflows.
agentSummary: Strong fit when local Playwright is not enough and an agent needs durable remote browser sessions.
bestFor: Remote browser automation, logged-in workflows, and agent web tasks.
cautionNotes: Key limitations: Use responsibly and respect site terms; browser automation can trigger risk systems. Respect robots.txt, site terms, rate limits, copyright, authentication boundaries, and anti-bot controls before asking an agent to crawl or extract content. API automation needs client-side throttling, idempotency where supported, pagination limits, retries, and audit logging. Browser automation can be brittle around UI changes, MFA, captchas, policy prompts, and hidden confirmation states.
pricingSummary: Public tiers and usage-based session pricing.
browserSupport: Core product is remote browser access.
